full_details: Your father had spoken to the master. Tomorrow morning is Hamnet's leave, and the sword is not for school. You told him he is back at eleven. You began to describe a cord, and Joan stopped you. Richard was already at the shop door. In the afternoon you gave Anne Mistress Ansell's opinion of the forsworn gentlemen, in the landlady's own words. Anne said the ladies were right to make them wait, and a twelvemonth was short. You said you would carry that sentence back as she said it. No shop was paid. The canvas was not opened.
one_sentence: You kept the sword on the nail, and Anne said a twelvemonth was short.
title: The sword stayed on the nail, and a twelvemonth was short
